knowledge-base.question: How can I create an account?
knowledge-base.answer: To create an account, click on the 'Sign Up' button on the top right corner of our website and follow the instructions to complete the registration process.

knowledge-base.question: Can I return a product if it was purchased during a promotional event?
knowledge-base.answer: Yes, you can return a product purchased during a promotional event. The refund will be processed based on the amount paid after any applicable discounts.
